name: aurelysn-vault
description: Local plugin marketplace for AureLysn Vault (D:\AureLysn) — Git safety, system administration, storage sidecars, fiction continuation studio, and design review

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Safe Git operations across all repositories (AureLysn Vault, Portfolio, and Subsystems): branch & commit discipline, PR & merge, history recovery, and 8 PreToolUse safety hooks (Bash + PowerShell with wrapped commands, plus file edits of guardrail files)

plugins.name: vault-ops
plugins.description: System administration for AureLysn Vault: verification gates (vault_doctor, vault_index, claim_check), 3-2-1 zip snapshots with a restore drill, session handoffs with reminders at session start and before compaction, hook rules written as vault notes (shadow mode first), pre-handoff verification checklist updates, and stale-index commit blocking

plugins.name: storekeeper
plugins.description: Binary storage and sidecar management for 02_Storage/ and 03_Atelier/02_Asset_Catalog/: asset scanning, sidecar authoring, path_rel verification, and safe file archiving

plugins.name: story-studio
plugins.description: Fiction continuation and original story studio for 05_Evasion/01_Oeuvre/: source ingestion, entity extraction, style profiling, drop-point analysis, 7-gate outline planning, chapter drafting with one gate for style, AI tells, POV leaks and broken output, blind continuity/POV verification whose findings must quote the text, and 6-step finalization

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Read-only design and portfolio audit for 03_Atelier/ and 04_Portfolio/ against Style DNA core and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (subagent art-auditor)
